safetyTiers.read_only_analytics: Pure local deterministic computation, spatial validation, or benchmark verification.
safetyTiers.external_network_read: Reads external hazard/humanitarian APIs with SSRF guards and prompt-injection sanitization.
safetyTiers.governance_write_gated: Includes state-mutating or publication tools gated by Draft-default, approval tokens, or explicit production flags.
